profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer
profile.summary:
*   About 11+ years of professional experience on large scale and highly integrated software systems analysis, design, development, testing & implementation as a System Analyst   and Software Developer.

*   All the phases of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and experienced to work as a team member as well as an individual performer under the large development groups.

*   Securing strong understanding of .NET Framework and .NET application architecture.

*   Experience of .Net Framework 2.0 - 3.5 - 4.0, Visual Studio 2005, 2008, 2010 and MVC Frame Work. 

*    Expert level command on C#.NET,  ASP.NET,  ADO.NET,  Web Services, LINQ, AJAX, Java Script, Cascading Style Sheets(CSS), VB6.0, XML, Microsoft Visual SourceSafe (VSS), TFS, Microsoft VISIO, MS SQL Server 2000-2005-2008, SQL Server Reporting Service (SSRS), SSIS & Cristal Repots

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
Domain: Wireless & RFID
Wi-Com Link - a unique Sensus solution specifically designed to integrate with industry leading, third party facility management systems.
Unique Features and Benefits of Wi-Com Sensus Link:
•Open database interface provides inbound and outbound data migration to any Lab Management System 
•Built on the Microsoft® Silverlight® platform, promoting stability, scalability, reliability and performance 
•Developed using Microsoft® BizTalk® RFID, allowing for a more powerful utilization of RFID technology 
•User-friendly web interface can be accessed from any PC, anywhere 
•Designed to function within any security criteria

Wi-Com Sensus*, powered by Allentown, streamlines and 
automates the census taking process using cardholders that are imbedded with RFID tags - the same wireless technology employed in access key cards and electronic toll collectors. This high tech approach reduces costs and ensures accuracy for both the facility and the researchers who work there.
